richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to a weakness in the material it is possible for the brain mounting situated on the alloy seat mount to fail. Should this occur it could result in the brain reservoir contacting the rear wheel spokes which could lead to the rider falling from the machine.
richiami.rimedio: Subject machines will have the alloy seat stay replaced.
richiami.titolo: REAR WHEEL SPOKES MAY BE IMPACTED

richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will have the handlebars replaced.
